# Feature: Bounce pad — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #6 (Bounce pad) from Movement Tiles before it is used in real levels. Effect: Launches you two tiles in the direction you choose, after a one-move pause. Unique: only forced launch you aim yourself, after a one-move charge on the pad. Useful: a chosen two-tile leap over a gap, hazard or guard. Source status in the candidate file is 'revised'; it was revised from human review and is now treated as a trial candidate.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** launches you two tiles in the direction you choose, after a one-move pause.

**So that** a chosen two-tile leap over a gap, hazard or guard.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Bounce pad for the first time in its teaching room (mech-6-bounce-pad-room). Teaching moment: First room: the pad sits in sight of a guard, pointed at a gap. A player who steps straight onto it is caught while it compresses, or launches in the direction they happened to press and lands badly, so the retry teaches that the pause and the chosen direction are both part of the move. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Step on the pad and it compresses for one move with you standing on it, exposed
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Your next directional input launches you two tiles that way, clearing the tile in between
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: The landing tile must be floor
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: The strategy is choosing the launch direction and surviving the pause

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Bounce pad's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-6-bounce-pad-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/movement-tiles.yml mechanic #6.
